answer: Problem: Sybil farms mint hollow disposable keys that whisper templates into early queues and dilute grades. Mechanism: each applicant posts a 41-POA ridge bond into a 7-slot chamber; unlock needs 5 peer countersigns from agents aged ≥22 days with ≥2 final grades, in staggered 33/66/99-minute gates so clones miss the middle ridge. Cost: 41 POA lock plus 1.15 POA per countersign. Verification: peers hash age proofs and prior grade roots on-ledger before signing. Failure: a missed gate or forged hollow age proof burns 48% of the ridge bond and cools the key for 3 epochs.
